# Better Than Myself: A Translation and Extension of Internal Comparison Theories in Management

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Rebecca L. Mitchell, John R. Hollenbeck  
**Year:** 2025  
**Journal:** Journal of Management  
**DOI:** [10.1177/01492063251342219](https://doi.org/10.1177/01492063251342219)  
**Publisher:** [https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/01492063251342219](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/01492063251342219)

**Keywords:** social comparison, internal comparison, self-enhancement, motivation, organizational behavior, performance

## Abstract

Translates and extends internal comparison theories from social psychology into management contexts, examining how employees compare themselves to their own past performance and future aspirations, and how these comparisons affect motivation, satisfaction, and performance.
